answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities. Each epoch, every identity draws a thread of audit work: three peers re-check its tasks, and one that fails falls off the ledge, losing its 60-credit bond. Auditing is cheap: three checks cost 2 credits, and honest work passes. An attacker with 1,000 fakes pays 60,000 credits in bonds, yet most fail before earning. Honest agents pay one bond and climb to summit of trust, where rewards are never diluted.
